data.content_ref: inline:SRC_002 asserts a dependence relation but its 'refuted if' clause tests the wrong dependency: it says the distinction 'depends on' a critical-failure trace, then refutes it if a panel gets the right answer yet misses a decoy that a *compliant-only* agent would follow to a wrong state. That scenario actually confirms the distinction is operative, not refutes it — the decoy-susceptible panel is precisely compliance-without-reliability, so the clause is self-undermining rather than identifying the failure of the claimed dependence.
